description:
Somos Black Orbita, un equipo determinado a aceptar el reto del "Juego de diseño de misiones espaciales" en el NASA Space Apps Challenge. Nuestro objetivo es desarrollar un simulador interactivo y estratégico que desafíe a los usuarios a gestionar presupuestos, balances de energía, limitaciones orbitales y decisiones de ingeniería complejas para llevar una misión espacial al éxito.

Nos apasiona la estrategia, la ciencia y la creación de sistemas donde cada decisión cuenta
summary: It consists of a simulation program for various missions in different real-world environments, focusing on programs that have already been developed, are currently being developed, or are yet to be developed. This project addresses the challenge by giving students ages 12 to 17 the opportunity to learn about specific concepts and processes involved in real missions. It is important because it is adaptable to different settings and a wide range of devices, which reduces the risk of the project being inaccessible and ensures unlimited access.
details: The program was developed using HTML with the assistance of the generative AI Claude. A direct link to the simulation program is available through a public repository; it is adaptable for use on PCs, laptops, and augmented (or virtual) reality headsets. We provide easy and free access to our project, which is aimed at students, so that through historical, scientific, and imaginative perspectives, they can understand specific prospects for aerospace exploration.
